purpose: Reserve all canonical owner Host slots and one shared Catalog lease before binding any serving request.

jobs.failure: After validation, inactive rank 3's monotonic clock advances by 60 seconds past renew_at (20 seconds). All ranks incorrectly return a ready cohort. The test expects an error record and fails with KeyError('failed_ranks').
jobs.method: Advance the local clock only after the validation vote completes, deterministically ordering readiness after renewal becomes due.

jobs.note: Before adding explicit device='cpu' to the two control-buffer constructors and testing construction under a meta-device context.

protocol.header: Ten int64 CPU values: version, round, phase, error flag, reserved Host bytes, lease byte length, four SHA-256 words.
protocol.group: Dedicated Gloo group, PP-major/TP-minor order, including inactive ranks. Default WORLD is rejected.
protocol.threading: One background caller per rank and matching call order. A concurrent call is rejected; inference communicates on a separate group.
protocol.capacity: Only active owners acquire slots. If any is full, release all new reservations and return None everywhere, without Catalog begin.
protocol.catalog: Only the aux owner calls begin. The request includes all owners and the sum of registered Host arena bytes. Validate returned dataset/sample/generation before using its credentials.
protocol.deadlines: Every local monotonic anchor precedes the capacity vote and aux begin. Validation and readiness reject leases already due for renewal; caller must recheck before binding/writing.
protocol.rollback: No CUDA or Store transfer has begun. Release owned unused slots and fail a known matching lease at the aux owner. Report cleanup failure collectively.
protocol.uncertain_begin: Lost response, invalid response identity, or failure to acknowledge rollback may leave only an unused Catalog reservation. Catalog expiry must reclaim it; no payload objects were produced.
protocol.poisoning: Transport or round/phase mismatch poisons the allocator. It cannot be reused; tear down the capture control group.

verification.isolation: Run reserve in a background thread concurrently with a WORLD all-reduce; all four inference results equal 6 while the dedicated group admits one cohort.
verification.device: Construct allocator under torch.device('meta'); explicit CPU buffers still complete actual Gloo collectives.
verification.recovery: Backpressure releases all newly acquired slots. Free the deliberately held slot and retry on the same allocator at round 2, receiving one agreed capture ID.

real_store.source: Synthetic local KV behind a mocked source pool; actual resource preparation, registered Host arenas, Gloo cohort allocator and Mooncake SDK.
real_store.startup_failure: Rank 2's insufficient Host budget rolls resource startup back before cohort creation.
real_store.success: Three active owners receive their registered slots from one cohort; inactive rank 3 receives metadata only.
real_store.verification: Independent provider reads exact rank-specific bytes after all owner processes exit. Aux retires the unused transport-test lease. The existing independent-owner snapshot publication test also passes.
real_store.limitation: The three raw transport keys are not Catalog-registered training objects or a published training sample.

limits: Serving does not call this allocator yet. Ready-cohort queues, request ticket propagation, lease renewal, bound-request cancellation/failure agreement, accepted-token delivery and descriptor/receipt exchange remain to be wired.
TP/PP gates remain closed; these tests do not validate distributed target inference, PD or cross-node RDMA.
Readiness cannot prevent lease expiry or process death after confirmation; caller must retain slots through transfer completion and enforce the Catalog fence.
Callbacks and group teardown require the serving supervisor's watchdog in addition to collective timeouts.
Catalog is a test double; production expiry/retention and recovery of uncertain reservations are external requirements.
Existing single-rank runtime inference was not rerun because serving production paths were unchanged.
